messages:
ariel: Quick FYI — the 2.14.0 promotion is blocked: staging CI e2e failing intermittently. Appears to be ephemeral schema names colliding when multiple runners run concurrently.
kim: Reproduced with `./ci/run-e2e --concurrency=5`. Failure snippet: 
```
OperationalError: CREATE SCHEMA tmp_orders_3 failed: relation "tmp_orders_3" already exists
  at tests/e2e/orders_flow.py:82
```
qa_runner: Non-deterministic — seen ~40% failure rate under parallel stress.
devops_bot: deploy v2.14.0-canary triggered (job 9923)
devops_bot: canary healthcheck failed, initiating rollback to previous image
toni_pm: Product prefers holding rather than risking a flaky deploy. Users expect reliability.
ariel: Two choices: (A) pin canary to last-good digest (ff12be) and set manual hold on promo, (B) quick test fix to append a unique run id to schema names and rerun canary.
kim: The fix is tiny: `schema = f"tmp_orders_{os.getenv('CI_RUN_ID', uuid4())}"`. I'll open a PR.
ariel: Immediate unblock plan: pin canary + block auto-promote so production unaffected. Then merge test fix and smoke.
rollbot: promo status updated: MANUAL_HOLD applied by ariel at 1745550150 (reason: staging e2e schema collision)
kim: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4350 opened — includes an assertion to prevent duplicate schema names.
qa_runner: Starting stress run on patched branch (target=50 runs). Will post results in ~45m.
ariel: I'll add a note to release notes and the release channel explaining the hold and the next steps.
devops_bot: audit: hold recorded (user=ariel, tag=block-promo) at 1745550155
toni_pm: Thanks. If QA green before the change window closes we can re-evaluate.
kim: First 20 runs passed without collision, continuing.
ariel: Great — reconvene at 1745550450 or drop results in-thread when QA finishes.
